rule Packed_UPX_With_AntiVM {
    meta:
        description = "Detects UPX-packed binaries with common anti-VM artifacts"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "INC-2026-1302"
        maltype = "Downloader, Cryptominer"
    strings:
        $upx = { 55 50 58 21 } // UPX header
        $anti_vm = "VMware" wide ascii
        $anti_vm2 = "VirtualBox" wide ascii
    condition:
        $upx and ($anti_vm or $anti_vm2)
}
